concept.title: Childcare for going back to work
concept.shortdesc: As a parent planning to return to work, I need to understand the childcare options near me, so that I can plan the return and know what it costs.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-005). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Maternity leave ending; unsure of the options and the terminology (nursery, childminder, children's centre, family hub).
A good result: The kinds of childcare available locally, how to find registered providers, and what help with cost exists.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.
